note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our city council is weighing free bus passes for secondary school students. There are 24,000 secondary students in the city. Today 9,000 students buy a student pass at $30 a month.

answers.common.decision: Whether to offer free passes to every secondary student or only to low-income students; the council votes.
answers.common.deadline: The council's transport committee next month.
answers.common.audience: Council members on the transport committee.
answers.common.materials: Passes are sold for 10 months of the school year. The transit budget can absorb $2,000,000 a year in lost fares. Low-income students who qualify for free school meals number 6,000, and 2,400 of those students already buy a pass.
answers.research-reporting.scope: Secondary school students in the city, one school year.
answers.research-reporting.sources: The council's fare and school meal figures.
